verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a standalone desktop IDE whose agents edit files, run shell commands and preview the app locally. Nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-hosted agent that autonomously builds, tests and demos a feature for later review. The managed inference service and the optional self-hosted 'stagewise Cloud' cover model access and accounts, not remote agent execution.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
